lines: See that heart? That's your SOUL. The very culmination of your being!
It starts off weak. Pasty. Unloved. Very... basement.
You want to make it stronger, right? Down here, we share our little... "friendship petals"~
Everyone has one. Some people have, like, nine.
That's the spirit!
You KNOW what these are?
* (You don't know what these are.)
* (...You know exactly what these are.)
Oh, you're FUN.
* The petals are vibrating.
* (Why are they vibrating.)
Here, we're all about good vibes~
...and soon you'll be FILLED with them.
Move around! Catch as many as you can!
Hey, buddy. You missed them.
Let's try again, okay?
Is this a JOKE, darling? Are you ALLERGIC?
RUN. INTO. THE. PETALS!!!
You idiot.
You really thought I'd share my petals for FREE?
In this world, it's YIFF or be YIFFED.
Why would ANYONE pass up a chance like this?
A gamer. Fresh. Unfluffed.
You fell on me. You crushed my babies.
And now? You're going to STAY.
Now hold still, darling~ you'd make a FABULOUS fox. Let's get you fluffy!
You think you're FUNNY?
I've been nice. I've been SO nice.
Now hold still, darling~ ...no. Actually? Don't.
DANCE.
